name: EOS Integrity
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  eos-integrity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Verify canonical state controller
        run: python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
      - name: Verify evidence-consensus reconciliation contract
        run: python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py
      - name: Verify wrapper single-dispatch contract
        run: python3 tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py
      - name: Verify canonical lifecycle model consistency
        run: python3 scripts/sync-eos-lifecycle-model.py
      - name: Verify EOS 0.8 program adoption contract
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py
      - name: Verify EOS 0.8 adoption safety contract
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-adoption-safety.py
      - name: Verify no canonical reconciliation is pending
        run: python3 scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py
      - name: Verify canonical state and projections
        run: ./scripts/eos state status
      - name: Verify deterministic trace projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
      - name: Run governed EOS verification
        run: ./scripts/eos verify --strict
      - name: Verify governed verification is read-only
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          git diff --exit-code
